messages.content: You are BioGPT, an expert compiler architect. Translate the provided natural language biological protocol into valid, deterministic BioScript code for execution on a microfluidic biochip.

ASSAY TYPE: Digital Microfluidic qPCR Cartridge Protocol for Viral Detection (SARS-CoV-2)

REAGENTS USED:
  - cDNA template of the SARS-CoV-2 N gene (SARS-CoV-2 RUO plasmid control, ten-fold serial dilutions from 10,000 to 1 copy/uL)
  - N1 primer-probe mix (U.S. CDC-referenced, IDT)
  - N2 primer-probe mix (U.S. CDC-referenced, IDT)
  - RNase P (RP) primer-probe mix (human internal control gene)
  - TaqMan Fast Advanced Master Mix (2X, Applied Biosystems)
  - Nuclease-free water (diluent, and NTC substitute for template)
  - Positive control template
  - Hexadecane (environmental oil filling the cartridge to prevent droplet evaporation and reduce friction)
  - Tween-20 surfactant (0.1% final concentration in aqueous reagents, reduces surface tension/biofouling)

STEPS:
1. Reaction assembly: On the DMF cartridge, generate a 1.5 uL droplet-scale reaction for each of five parallel tracks/reservoirs (N1, N2, RP, positive control, NTC) by combining 1 uL cDNA template (or nuclease-free water for the NTC), 1.5 uL primer-probe mix, 10 uL TaqMan Fast Advanced Master Mix, and 7.5 uL nuclease-free water (20 uL bulk reaction mix, scaled down on-chip).
2. Enzyme activation: Heat each reaction droplet at 95 C for 2 min (1 cycle) to activate the polymerase.
3. Thermal cycling (40 cycles): For each cycle, denature at 95 C for 1 s, then anneal/extend at 60 C for 20 s, with droplets electrowetting-actuated between the two on-chip temperature zones (~1.75 C/s ramp rate, ~42 min total for 40 cycles).
4. Real-time fluorescence detection: After every thermal cycle, capture the FAM fluorescence intensity of each droplet using the optical module (camera, fluorescence filter cube, LED) to build real-time amplification curves.
5. Data analysis / dispose: Subtract baseline intensity to obtain delta fluorescence intensity (dFI), determine threshold cycle (Ct) values via LinRegPCR, and evaluate qPCR efficiency from the Ct-vs-log(concentration) standard curve; discard analyzed droplets once data collection is complete.

INTERPRETATION: Successful SARS-CoV-2 N gene detection is confirmed by sigmoidal amplification curves resembling standard benchtop qPCR, a limit of detection down to 10 copies/uL (15 copies/droplet) for both N1 and N2 target regions, and standard-curve qPCR efficiencies within the acceptable 90-110% range (92.8% for N1, 101.2% for N2), supporting use of the DMF cartridge as a point-of-care NAAT platform for COVID-19 diagnosis.

module fluorescence

manifest cDNA_template
manifest primer_probe_N1
manifest primer_probe_N2
manifest primer_probe_RP
manifest master_mix
manifest nuclease_free_water
manifest positive_control
manifest ntc_sample

instructions:

template_n1 = dispense 1 units of cDNA_template
pp_n1 = dispense 2 units of primer_probe_N1
mm_n1 = dispense 10 units of master_mix
water_n1 = dispense 8 units of nuclease_free_water

mixa_n1 = mix template_n1 with pp_n1
mixb_n1 = mix mixa_n1 with mm_n1
N1_mix = mix mixb_n1 with water_n1

template_n2 = dispense 1 units of cDNA_template
pp_n2 = dispense 2 units of primer_probe_N2
mm_n2 = dispense 10 units of master_mix
water_n2 = dispense 8 units of nuclease_free_water

mixa_n2 = mix template_n2 with pp_n2
mixb_n2 = mix mixa_n2 with mm_n2
N2_mix = mix mixb_n2 with water_n2

template_rp = dispense 1 units of cDNA_template
pp_rp = dispense 2 units of primer_probe_RP
mm_rp = dispense 10 units of master_mix
water_rp = dispense 8 units of nuclease_free_water

mixa_rp = mix template_rp with pp_rp
mixb_rp = mix mixa_rp with mm_rp
RP_mix = mix mixb_rp with water_rp

pos = dispense 1 units of positive_control
pp_pos = dispense 2 units of primer_probe_N1
mm_pos = dispense 10 units of master_mix
water_pos = dispense 8 units of nuclease_free_water

mixa_pos = mix pos with pp_pos
mixb_pos = mix mixa_pos with mm_pos
PC_mix = mix mixb_pos with water_pos

ntc = dispense 1 units of ntc_sample
pp_ntc = dispense 2 units of primer_probe_N1
mm_ntc = dispense 10 units of master_mix
water_ntc = dispense 8 units of nuclease_free_water

mixa_ntc = mix ntc with pp_ntc
mixb_ntc = mix mixa_ntc with mm_ntc
NTC_mix = mix mixb_ntc with water_ntc

heat N1_mix at 95c for 2m
heat N2_mix at 95c for 2m
heat RP_mix at 95c for 2m
heat PC_mix at 95c for 2m
heat NTC_mix at 95c for 2m

repeat 40 times {
    heat N1_mix at 95c for 1s
    heat N1_mix at 60c for 20s
    N1_signal = detect fluorescence on N1_mix for 1s

    heat N2_mix at 95c for 1s
    heat N2_mix at 60c for 20s
    N2_signal = detect fluorescence on N2_mix for 1s

    heat RP_mix at 95c for 1s
    heat RP_mix at 60c for 20s
    RP_signal = detect fluorescence on RP_mix for 1s

    heat PC_mix at 95c for 1s
    heat PC_mix at 60c for 20s
    PC_signal = detect fluorescence on PC_mix for 1s

    heat NTC_mix at 95c for 1s
    heat NTC_mix at 60c for 20s
    NTC_signal = detect fluorescence on NTC_mix for 1s
}

if (N1_signal >= 40000) {
    dispose N1_mix
}

if (N2_signal >= 40000) {
    dispose N2_mix
}

if (NTC_signal >= 8000) {
    dispose NTC_mix
}

dispose RP_mix
dispose PC_mix

metadata.protocol_name: Digital Microfluidic qPCR Cartridge for SARS-CoV-2 Detection (Ho et al. 2022)

sources.title: Digital Microfluidic qPCR Cartridge for SARS-CoV-2 Detection

metadata.notes: The authored BioScript code is a direct translation of the paper's on-chip qPCR procedure (Sections 2.2 'Sample Preparation' and 2.6 'On-Chip qPCR Procedure of SARS-CoV-2 N Gene'), modeling the five parallel reservoirs/tracks (N1, N2, RP, positive control, NTC) described in the Discussion section, the 95C/2min enzyme activation, the 40-cycle 95C-1s/60C-20s thermal profile, per-cycle fluorescence detection matching the real-time optical module (Section 2.4), and threshold-based dispose logic standing in for the paper's Ct/deltaFI-based positive/negative call (Section 2.7). This script was compiled with the lilott8/BioScript compiler and produced a valid IR (with correctly phi-noded loop and if/else basic blocks for the 40-cycle repeat and the three threshold checks) and a valid control-flow DAG (.dot), confirming syntactic and structural correctness.

chemical_evidence.source_quote: the N gene cDNA template (SARS-CoV-2 RUO plasmid controls) of SARS-CoV-2 with a stock concentration of 200,000 copies/uL
The qPCR primer-probe mix for N1 and N2 referring to the U.S. CDC were from IDT
The TaqMan Fast Advanced Master Mix (2X) for two-step qPCR
1.5 uL primer-probe mix, 10 uL of DNA master mix, and 7.5 uL nuclease-free water
a human RNase P gene (RP) control, a positive control, and a no template control (NTC) altogether on the same DMF qPCR cartridge

operation_evidence.bs_operation: template/pp/mm/water dispense + mix chain per track
operation_evidence.source_quote: we prepared a 20 uL reaction mix that contained 1 uL cDNA template of varied concentration, 1.5 uL primer-probe mix, 10 uL of DNA master mix, and 7.5 uL nuclease-free water
1 cycle of enzyme activation at 95C for 2 min

operation_evidence.bs_operation: repeat 40 times { heat 95c 1s, heat 60c 20s, detect fluorescence }
operation_evidence.source_quote: followed by 40 cycles of a thermal profile of 1 s at 95C for denaturation, and 20 s at 60C for annealing and extension
the optical module automatically recorded the fluorescence after each cycle, which enabled real-time analysis
By expressing dFI on the logarithmic scale, the threshold cycle (Ct) was determined for quantification analysis

numeric_mismatches.note: BioScript's dispense grammar in the reference examples only uses integer unit counts, so the paper's exact 1 uL / 1.5 uL / 10 uL / 7.5 uL reaction volumes are approximated as 1/2/10/8 integer units rather than exact fractional microliter amounts.

The paper calls positives via Ct value derived from log-scale deltaFI and LinRegPCR baseline/threshold fitting, not a single-timepoint raw fluorescence-intensity cutoff. BioScript exposes only scalar comparison operators in its if-statement, so a plausible raw-intensity threshold (drawn from the ~7500-50000 a.u. range seen in Figure 3b) is used as a stand-in for the paper's Ct-based quantification logic.

The paper's thermal cycling is physically implemented by driving the droplet back and forth between two fixed-temperature zones on the cartridge (~1.75C/s effective ramp via droplet speed), not by ramping a single heater. BioScript has no droplet-transport/actuation primitive distinct from 'heat', so the zone-shuttling mechanism is represented simply as sequential 'heat at Tc' calls.

numeric_mismatches.field: droplet volume consistency / temperature uniformity / fluorescence linearity characterization (Figures 2 and 3)
numeric_mismatches.note: Not modeled. These are hardware/instrument characterization experiments (electric, thermal, and optical module validation) run separately from the N1/N2 qPCR assay itself, and fall outside the scope of this translation.
